findings.issue: Common noun מִשְׁכַּן (H4908, masculine singular construct) is left as the untranslated transliteration mishkán.
Hiphil perfect 3ms is rendered as future subjunctive trajere; person, number, hiphil bringing, and the 3ms object suffix still match.

notes: Other clauses match the packet, including both יהוה tokens as Jehová.
